# Supertext SDK (bundled copy)

Built JavaScript of the TypeScript part of the [Supertext SDK](https://github.com/Supertext/Supertext-API-SDK-and-Guide) (`sdk/typescript`), version 0.1.0, commit `232c47888abc0b7d44c2cbe6e9d13bd5b7655cc5`. `package.json` makes it the `supertext-sdk` devDependency that the extension build bundles into `dist/`.

Don't edit these files: fix the SDK in its own repository, then run `scripts/vendor-sdk.sh`.
